template.label: Original Research Manuscript
template.description: Original Research Manuscript — master starting template (v1.0). Intended use: Interventional clinical studies; adapt the reporting guideline and content for observational, diagnostic, systematic review, or other designs.

provenance.note: This is a working manuscript starting point, not a regulatory-approved or journal-approved submission form. Journal and study-specific requirements take precedence.
provenance.generatedBy: manuscript_to_json.py (sections = numbered Heading 1s; sub-headings, placeholders and table shells = starter HTML)

documentControl.placeholder: [Protocol version/date; SAP version/date; CSR version/date; tables/listings/figures]

sections.title: Title page
sections.guidance: Confirm authorship against ICMJE criteria, author order, affiliations, and journal title-page rules. Do not infer authors or contributions.
sections.starterHtml:
[Concise informative manuscript title specifying population, intervention, comparator, and study design where appropriate]

Short running title: [≤ journal limit]

Authors: [Full names, degrees, affiliations, ORCID IDs as required]

Corresponding author: [Name, institution, postal address, email]

Trial registration: [Registry, identifier, registration date, URL]

Word count: [Main text] | Tables: [n] | Figures: [n] | Supplementary files: [n]

sections.title: Abstract
sections.guidance: Use the target journal’s structured/unstructured format and word limit. For randomized trials, align with CONSORT for abstracts.
sections.starterHtml:
Importance / Background

[Clinical problem and knowledge gap]

Objective

[Primary study objective]

Design, setting, and participants

[Design, sites, recruitment period, eligibility, sample size]

Interventions

[Arms, dose, duration]

Main outcomes and measures

[Prespecified primary outcome, timepoint, analysis]

Results

[Randomized/analyzed N; main numerical effect estimate, precision interval, safety summary]

Conclusions

[Balanced conclusion supported by results]

Trial registration

[Registry and identifier]

Keywords: [3–6 journal-compliant terms, preferably MeSH]

sections.title: Introduction
sections.guidance: Use numbered Vancouver citations in order of first appearance: [1], [2], etc.; verify each claim against a source.
sections.starterHtml:
3.1 Background and unmet need

[Summarize disease burden, current treatment landscape, and key references.]

3.2 Scientific rationale

[Explain the intervention, mechanism, prior evidence, and evidence gap.]

3.3 Objectives and hypotheses

[State prespecified primary objective, key secondary objectives, and hypothesis.]

sections.title: Methods
sections.guidance: Methods must reconcile with approved protocol, SAP and CSR; distinguish prespecified from post hoc analyses. Report dates and approvals accurately.
sections.starterHtml:
4.1 Study design and oversight

[Phase, randomized/nonrandomized, parallel-group/crossover, allocation ratio, blinding, multicenter status, countries, study dates.]

4.2 Ethics and informed consent

[Ethics committee/IRB approvals, consent procedure, applicable ethical standards.]

4.3 Participants

[Inclusion/exclusion criteria, recruitment, setting, and screening procedures.]

4.4 Randomization, allocation concealment, and blinding

[Sequence generation, stratification, concealment, roles blinded, unblinding procedures; mark not applicable where relevant.]

4.5 Interventions and comparators

[Dose, route, frequency, duration, permitted/concomitant therapies, adherence.]

4.6 Outcomes and assessments

[Primary/secondary endpoints, exact definitions, assessment timepoints, measurement instruments, safety outcomes.]

4.7 Sample size determination

[Assumptions, power, alpha, clinically meaningful effect, attrition.]

4.8 Statistical analysis

[Analysis sets, estimand, models, covariates, missing data, multiplicity, sensitivity analyses, interim analyses, software.]

4.9 Protocol amendments and deviations

[Important post-start changes, dates, rationale, impact on analysis.]

sections.title: Results
sections.guidance: Do not fabricate values. Preserve denominators, units, analysis sets, rounding, and CSR/TLF traceability; avoid interpreting findings in Results.
sections.starterHtml:
5.1 Participant disposition

[Screened, excluded, randomized, treated, completed, discontinued; reasons; cite Figure 1.]

5.2 Baseline demographics and clinical characteristics

[Analysis populations, baseline comparability; cite Table 1.]

5.3 Primary efficacy outcome

[Numerator/denominator or summary statistics by arm, effect estimate, 95% CI, p-value if applicable, analysis population/timepoint.]

5.4 Secondary and exploratory outcomes

[Results in prespecified order; label exploratory/post hoc findings.]

5.5 Safety and tolerability

[Exposure, TEAEs, serious AEs, AESIs, discontinuations, deaths; denominators and coding dictionary/version.]

5.6 Additional analyses

[Subgroups, sensitivity analyses, protocol deviations, missing data as applicable.]

sections.title: Discussion
sections.starterHtml:
6.1 Principal findings

[Summarize primary and clinically meaningful findings without repeating every result.]

6.2 Interpretation in context

[Compare with prior literature; explain agreement/disagreement and clinical relevance.]

6.3 Strengths and limitations

[Design strengths, bias, missingness, generalizability, multiplicity, follow-up limitations.]

6.4 Clinical and research implications

[What findings imply and what further studies are warranted.]

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.starterHtml: [Concise evidence-based conclusion consistent with prespecified outcomes and limitations; avoid overstating causality or efficacy.]

sections.title: Declarations and publication information
sections.starterHtml:
Ethics approval and consent

[Committee names, approval IDs/dates, consent statement.]

Consent for publication

[Applicable statement or Not applicable.]

Trial registration

[Registry, number, date; note retrospective registration if applicable.]

Funding and sponsor role

[Funding source, grant number, role in design, conduct, analysis, writing, publication decision.]

Conflicts of interest / competing interests

[Author-specific disclosures; ICMJE disclosure forms if requested.]

Author contributions

[Author-specific contributions; CRediT taxonomy if required; all authors approve final manuscript.]

Acknowledgments and medical writing support

[Contributors not meeting authorship criteria, editorial support, funding.]

Data sharing / availability

[Availability, access conditions, repository, protocol/SAP availability where applicable.]

Use of AI-assisted tools

[Disclosure per journal policy, including tool and human oversight where required.]

checklist.label: All placeholders resolved; target journal formatting applied
Study design and reporting guideline confirmed (e.g., CONSORT 2025 for randomized trials)
Objectives, endpoints, populations, and timepoints match protocol/SAP/CSR
All results reconciled against approved tables, listings, and figures
Numerical consistency across abstract, text, tables, figures, and supplements
Randomization, masking, sample size, missing data, and estimands accurately reported
Safety denominators, AE terms, and exposure verified
Ethics, registration, funding, data sharing, COI, and authorship statements complete
References verified; Vancouver numbering sequential; all figures/tables cited
Author approval and sponsor publication process documented
